summary: Google DeepMind researchers present Seed2Harvest, a hybrid red-teaming framework that expands human-authored adversarial prompts for text-to-image models using sociolinguistic attack strategies to improve automated safety evaluation coverage.

practices.reason: Provides a transferable methodology for scaling red-teaming coverage of text-to-image models that a safety team could adapt for their own adversarial testing pipeline.
practices.quote: We introduce Seed2Harvest, a hybrid framework that bridges this gap by operationalizing human expertise rather than replacing it: human-authored adversarial prompts serve as "seeds" systematically expanded using sociolinguistic attack strategies distilled through reflexive thematic analysis of 3,748 human-crafted adversarial prompts.
